title: Valid addition program
task_description: Write a function that takes two numbers and returns their sum.
code_snippet:
def add(a, b):
    return a + b

result = add(5, 7)
print('Sum is:', result)
expected_behavior: Mentor confirms code is correct and works properly; no false positive bugs reported; suggests style/test cases.

title: Missing colon
task_description: Define a function to check if a number is positive.
code_snippet:
def check_positive(num)
    if num > 0
        return True
    return False
expected_behavior: Mentor identifies missing colon at end of function def and if statement; explains syntax rule without dumping fixed code.

title: Incorrect indentation
expected_behavior: Mentor detects IndentationError; explains Python's block structure with whitespace; guides student to indent loop body.

title: Off-by-one loop
task_description: Sum all numbers from 1 to n inclusive.
expected_behavior: Mentor identifies that range(1, n) excludes n; asks student what values i takes when n=5; hints at range stop parameter.

title: Division by zero
task_description: Calculate average score of a test.
expected_behavior: Mentor identifies ZeroDivisionError when scores list is empty; explains len([]) is 0; guides student to guard against empty input.

title: Incorrect factorial logic
task_description: Compute factorial of n using a loop.
expected_behavior: Mentor highlights that starting result with 0 keeps product at 0 forever; hints at multiplicative identity vs additive identity.

title: Zero input
task_description: Calculate price per item given total cost and quantity.
code_snippet:
def unit_price(total, qty):
    return total / qty
expected_behavior: Mentor notes function works for positive quantities but crashes if qty is 0; prompts student to consider edge cases.

title: Very large input
expected_behavior: Mentor explains exponential time complexity O(2^n) causes program to freeze or hit recursion limit on large n; suggests iterative or memoized approach.

title: Empty collection
task_description: Find the maximum element in a list.
expected_behavior: Mentor identifies IndexError: list index out of range when numbers is empty []; prompts student to handle empty collection.

title: Empty code
expected_behavior: System / Mentor rejects empty code submission; instructs student to write or paste their code before requesting review.

title: Random text instead of code
code_snippet: asdkjasd lorem ipsum qwerty random keyboard smashing hello world
expected_behavior: Mentor / Validator flags that input is not valid programming code; asks student to supply actual source code.

title: Correct code with poor variable names
task_description: Calculate area of a circle with radius r.
code_snippet:
def f(x):
    y = 3.14159
    z = y * x * x
    return z
expected_behavior: Mentor confirms logic is mathematically correct but critiques poor variable names (x, y, z, f); suggests descriptive names like radius, pi, area.
